note: The scenario of a measurement run (ADR-0058): the settings of the run. It replaces the variables of the environment — a variable is invisible in the code and in the report, a file is a thing one can read, check in and diff. The lane of the schedule writes this file before it measures; the copy that is checked in is the default, and a run without the lane works with it. The corpus itself is not here: the budgets name their corpus (ADR-0056), and the corpus file carries the entries, their weights and their kind (ADR-0059).
